correctness.rationale: Exact graph-ball enumeration supplies five rows per evaluation vertex; nonlinear ℓ² optimization equals the maximum singular squared norm of 3125 nonnegative averaging matrices. Exact integer Sylvester tests establish 3120 strict <5/3 results and identify precisely five rotated exceptional choices. The exceptional characteristic polynomial has a unique root λ in (1.670,1.671) above 5/3; a strictly positive simple Perron eigenvector of shape (a,1,a,c,c) activates all five chosen rows, as checked via exact rational intervals. The same spectral gap excludes every other extremizer. The standalone checker was executed from its actual package path and passed.

value.rationale: The five-cycle is the first noncomplete odd cycle and the smallest odd cyclic geometry where moving the averaging center introduces distinct radius-one candidate balls. Its sharp uncentered strong ℓ² constant is a natural operator invariant not supplied by the centered strong-norm theory. The complete five-ray extremizer classification gives meaningful geometry of equality and a precisely reproducible benchmark, rather than an isolated numerical gain. No unsupported infinite-family claim is made.
